title: 第7章 飞机场灰衣男第8章 严冰传授武功
content_zh:
“严冰，我劝你退下，不然别怪我不客气。”
平头男子站出来，指着平胸女，严厉警告。
“蔡鸡，上次教训得不够是不是？”
严冰目光冰冷，在她的逼视下，一群小混混竟然连退几步。
“咱们有大哥罩着，怕什么？”
蔡机一巴掌拍在一名后退的手下头上，下令：“给我砸。”
一群小混混拿着铁棍，对着店里的东西就是一顿乱砸。
严冰动了。
别看她只是一个女子，动起手来干净利落，潇洒之极。
仅仅片刻，几名砸店的小混混全部倒在地上，惨叫连连。
“兰少，还请出手。”
蔡鸡连忙朝门外大喊。
一名身穿灰衣的男子，步履沉稳地走了进来，头上戴着一顶小黑帽。
“身手不错，可惜，终究只是外家高手，花拳绣腿而已。”
灰衣男子将帽子摘下，递给旁边的蔡鸡，朝严冰逼近。
严冰右腿蹬地，整个人凌空飞起，左腿横扫，潇洒凌厉。
灰衣男子右手一抓，精准抓住严冰左腿。
严冰身体三百六十度旋转，右腿狠狠朝灰衣男子扫去。
灰衣男子左手阻隔，严冰这一脚仿佛踢在一块铁板上。
“女人学什么武功，回去生孩子吧！”

灰衣男讥笑一声，用力一拉，严冰两条大腿被扳开，胯下无限扩大。
严冰身体柔韧性足够，可惜裤子崩不住，当场胯下开裂。
“红色的，原来是个闷骚女。”
蔡鸡哈哈大笑，一群小弟也跟着笑了起来，空气中全是淫秽的笑声。
严冰气得肺都快炸了，可惜双腿被抓住，根本无力反抗。
就在她颜面尽扫之际，一只鞋子砸了过来。
灰衣男子没将鞋子放在心上，顺手弹飞。
砰！
平平无奇的一只鞋，竟然蕴含着极大力量，将灰衣男子震退好几步。
“谁？”
灰衣男子一声怒吼。
楼上走下一男一女，女的是永春堂的老板娘何诗韵，男的是一名陌生面孔的年轻男子，脚上缺了只鞋子，跟地上的鞋子一模一样，显然是他出手。
“阁下何人，为何要坏我的事？”
灰衣男子目光炯炯地盯着张扬，眼神中露出忌惮之色。
content_en:
"Yan Bing, I advise you to step back, otherwise don't blame me for being rude."
The flat-headed man stood up, pointed at the flat-chested woman, and gave a stern warning.
"Caiji, didn't you teach me enough last time?"
Yan Bing's eyes were cold, and under her gaze, a group of gangsters even took a few steps back.
"We have big brother protecting us, what are we afraid of?"
Cai Ji slapped a subordinate on the head who retreated and ordered: "Smash it to me."
A group of gangsters took iron rods and smashed things in the store.
Yan Bing moved.
Even though she is just a woman, she moves her hands neatly and elegantly.
In just a moment, the gangsters who smashed the store all fell to the ground, screaming in agony.
"Master Lan, please take action."
Cai Ji quickly shouted out the door.
A man in gray clothes walked in calmly, wearing a little black hat on his head.
"The skills are good, but unfortunately, after all, they are just outsiders who use their skills to show off their skills."
The man in gray took off his hat, handed it to Cai Ji next to him, and approached Yan Bing.
Yan Bing's right leg kicked off the ground, and he flew up into the air. His left leg swept across, cool and sharp.
The man in gray grabbed his right hand and accurately grabbed Yan Bing's left leg.
Yan Bing rotated his body 360 degrees and swept his right leg towards the man in gray.
The man in gray blocked the attack with his left hand, and Yan Bing's kick seemed to hit an iron plate.
"What kind of martial arts can women learn? Go back and give birth to children!"
The man in gray sneered, and with a strong pull, Yan Bing's thighs were spread apart, and his crotch expanded infinitely.
Yan Bing's body was flexible enough, but unfortunately his pants couldn't collapse and his crotch cracked on the spot.
"The red one turns out to be a slutty girl."
Cai Ji laughed loudly, and a group of younger brothers also laughed, and the air was filled with obscene laughter.
Yan Bing was so angry that his lungs almost exploded. Unfortunately, his legs were grabbed and he was unable to resist.
Just when her face was completely wiped out, a shoe hit her.
The man in gray didn't take the shoes seriously and flicked them away.
Bang!
An ordinary shoe actually contained great power, knocking the man in gray back several steps.
"Who?"
The man in gray roared angrily.
A man and a woman walked upstairs. The woman was He Shiyun, the proprietress of Yongchun Hall, and the man was a young man with an unfamiliar face. He was missing a shoe, which was exactly the same as the shoe on the ground. It was obviously his fault.
"Who are you, and why do you want to ruin my affairs?"
The man in gray clothes stared at Zhang Yang with a look of fear in his eyes.
